detail.construction: Library module (reused, read-only). Tree (base, point, grad : ℕ → ℕ): step j creates node j+1 from node base j, evaluates one stochastic gradient (call j) at node point j and weights the new edge by the stochastic gradient of call grad j; WellFormed requires base j, point j, grad j ≤ j. Tree.repr/depth/ancestors/dist by recursion over parents; dist = max of the two depths minus the depth of the deepest common ancestor. IsMainBranch m: m 0 = 0, node m (k+1) is a child of node m k; auxSample m k = grad (m (k+1) - 1), auxNode = point of that call. Hist/Tree.realize/Tree.vertex realise the tree from the sample tape; stepSize/horizon are Theorem 2.4's; Public (d, gamma, x0, tree, branch, K); birch q is the template algorithm with a uniform seed in Fin (K+1) that processes tree steps in order (one oracle call each) and outputs node branch(seed); gradientOracle P g answers a query x with g x (tape k). EpsStationary is the problem's stationarity notion.

detail.construction: All three methods are encoded as computation trees (library Tree) run by the library executor birch. Shared worker-chain builder: given src : ℕ → ℕ (for main-branch step k, the main-branch index of the model w the worker computing the k-th main-branch gradient started from) and cont : ℕ → Bool (true iff step k continues the same worker's local chain as step k-1), chainTree src cont has two tree steps per main-branch step k: step 2k evaluates a fresh stochastic gradient (grad 2k = 2k) at the worker point z_k = chainAux k (= node 2k-1, the worker's previous local iterate, if cont k; else node 2·src k, the main-branch model it started from) and creates the worker's next local iterate z_k - γ g_k as node 2k+1; step 2k+1 creates the main-branch node 2k+2 = x^{k+1} = x^k - γ g_k reusing the same stochastic gradient (grad = 2k). chainBranch k = 2k. Thus x^{k+1} = x^k - γ ∇f(z^k; ξ^k) with z^k the worker's local iterate, as in the source trees. chainStep L σ ε Rt = min (1/(2 Rt L)) (if σ = 0 then 1/(2 Rt L) else ε/(4σ²L)). Local SGD (TREELOC/ALGLOC): localOffsets n M r = {Σ_{j<i} M r j : i} (start offsets of the workers' blocks in round r), localSrc B k = B·⌊k/B⌋ (round start N_r), localCont n B M k = (k mod B ∉ localOffsets n M ⌊k/B⌋), localTree = chainTree localSrc localCont; localStep L σ ε B = min (1/(2BL)) (if σ = 0 then 1/(2BL) else ε/(4σ²L)); localHorizon = ⌈4BLΔ/ε + 8σ²LΔ/ε²⌉₊. Cycle SGD (ALGCYC/TREECYC): workers 0..n-1, group g = {i : ⌊i/s⌋ = g}, cycleGroup n s g = its size, cycleLength n s = ⌈n/s⌉ = (n+s-1)/s, loop t synchronizes group t mod ⌈n/s⌉ whose workers have each done cycleSteps t = min(t+1, ⌈n/s⌉) local steps; cyclePos t = Σ_{u<t} cycleGroup(u mod ⌈n/s⌉)·cycleSteps u is the main-branch length before loop t; cycleLoop k = greatest t ≤ k with cyclePos t ≤ k (the loop containing step k); cycleSrc k = cyclePos(t+1-⌈n/s⌉) if t ≥ ⌈n/s⌉ (model after the group's previous synchronization) else 0; cycleCont k = ((k - cyclePos t) mod cycleSteps t ≠ 0); cycleStep = min (s/(4n²L)) (if σ = 0 then s/(4n²L) else ε/(4σ²L)); cycleHorizon = ⌈8n²LΔ/(sε) + 8σ²LΔ/ε²⌉₊. Async-Local SGD (ALGAL/TREEAL): asyncSrc M δ k = M·(⌊k/M⌋ - δ ⌊k/M⌋) (the b-th accepted sum, b = ⌊k/M⌋, started at w^{b-δ_b} = x^{M(b-δ_b)}), asyncCont M k = (k mod M ≠ 0); asyncStep = min (1/(2(B+M-1)L)) (if σ = 0 then … else ε/(4σ²L)) (user-approved corrected step); asyncHorizon = ⌈4(B+M-1)LΔ/ε + 8σ²LΔ/ε²⌉₊.
